strategies.name: Baseline Iterative Selective All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations where each rank zeros out blocks outside its window before each collective, then divides by coverage counts. Uses 8 all-reduce dispatches with full tensor payload (1280 elements) per dispatch. Trades simplicity and correctness for high dispatch count; no fusion or pipelining.

strategies.name: Fused Block-Parallel Reduce-Scatter All-Gather
strategies.desc: Decomposes into reduce-scatter by block ownership followed by local scaling, then all-gather to broadcast results. Uses 2-4 dispatches (reduce-scatter + all-gather per dependency layer, potentially fused across layers). Reduces total communication volume by avoiding redundant full-tensor all-reduces; trades algorithmic complexity for fewer dispatches.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Tree Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploits potential multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions (28 ranks per node if 8 nodes) followed by inter-node reductions, then broadcast back. Uses 16-24 dispatches (2-3 per dependency layer × 8 layers) but with smaller per-dispatch payloads. Optimizes for bandwidth-latency product on hierarchical interconnect.

strategies.name: Pipelined Sliding-Window All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Overlaps computation of coverage counts and block masking with successive all-reduce waves using asynchronous dispatch and double-buffering. Still uses 8 all-reduce dispatches but hides local computation latency between collectives. Maintains same total data movement but reduces wall-clock time through pipeline parallelism.

strategies.name: Pre-Computed Routing with Single Consolidated Collective
strategies.desc:
Pre-computes the final block-to-rank routing matrix, performs one all-to-all or personalized all-reduce where each rank sends/receives only needed blocks directly to/from covering ranks, then local assembly. Uses 1-2 dispatches with non-uniform payloads. Minimizes dispatch overhead at the cost of complex addressing and potential load imbalance.
